sources.note: Nothing on stress/accent. Sec. 3 (p.4) reports second-hand from Lu & Lu 2011: 'Awu has a three-way voicing contrast.. and observes only 3 tones, namely the high-level [55], mid-level [33], and low-falling tones. Awu also displays nasalization.' p.2: 'Awu phonology has not been adequately described yet'. Appendix 1 reproduces the ~200-word Awu list (Lu & Lu 2011:246-256) with tone numbers only.
